import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open Real

theorem algebra_9onxpypzleqsum2onxpy
  (x y z : ℝ)
  (h₀ : 0 < x ∧ 0 < y ∧ 0 < z) :
  9 / (x + y + z) ≤ 2 / (x + y) + 2 / (y + z) + 2 / (z + x) := by
  -- extract the positivity hypotheses
  rcases h₀ with ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩
  have hxy : 0 < x + y := add_pos hx hy
  have hyz : 0 < y + z := add_pos hy hz
  have hzx : 0 < z + x := add_pos hz hx
  have hsum : 0 < x + y + z := add_pos (add_pos hx hy) hz
  -- clear denominators; all denominators are non‑zero thanks to the positivity lemmas above
  have : (9 : ℝ) / (x + y + z) ≤ 2 / (x + y) + 2 / (y + z) + 2 / (z + x) := by
    field_simp [hx.ne', hy.ne', hz.ne', hxy.ne', hyz.ne', hzx.ne', hsum.ne']
    -- after `field_simp` the goal is a polynomial inequality that follows from
    -- the classical Nesbitt inequality; `nlinarith` can close it automatically.
    nlinarith
  exact this
```
